mapper.select: SELECT id, material_code, material_name, material_type, source_type, group_code, file_id, file_name, file_ext, file_size, link_url, link_status, visibility, cover_file_id, description, user_code, tenant_code, sort, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, remark, version FROM mdm_material WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND group_code IN (#{item}) ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT m.id, m.material_code, m.material_name, m.material_type, m.source_type, m.group_code, m.file_id, m.file_name, m.file_ext, m.file_size, m.link_url, m.link_status, m.visibility, m.cover_file_id, m.description, m.user_code, m.tenant_code, m.sort, m.create_time, m.create_by, m.update_time, m.update_by, m.remark, m.version, COUNT(r.id) AS ref_count FROM mdm_material m LEFT JOIN mdm_material_ref r ON m.material_code = r.material_code AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND m.material_type = #{materialType} GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY ref_count DESC, m.id DESC
